remarks: Prime .2-Acre Lot in Prestigious Shippan Neighborhood - Stamford, CT An exceptional opportunity to build your dream home in the highly sought-after, luxury enclave of Shippan. This .2-acre parcel is perfectly situated within a serene, single-family residential zone, offering the ideal canvas for a custom residence tailored to your exact specifications. The lot features raw, buildable land with no existing structures to remove and is equipped with the "Big 3"-Natural Gas, City Water, and City Sewer readily available at the street. Nestled in the prestigious Shippan neighborhood, known for its proximity to Long Island Sound, beaches, and vibrant Stamford downtown, this rare offering combines the tranquility of suburban living with convenient access to city amenities. Whether you're a builder or a future homeowner, this lot represents a unique chance to invest in one of Stamford's most desirable neighborhoods. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity.
